title: Test-run UI pages history through the existing GET /api/test-runs and exact-id routes instead of the snapshot
outcome: The Test Runs panel retrieves paged history and exact-id evidence through the existing read-only routes, while preserving live status, badges, waits and safe recorded-path fallback. Backend snapshot reduction and retention remain owned by the parent.
acceptance: The Test Runs panel reads history through the existing paged GET /api/test-runs route, loads a first page on open or project change, fetches further pages only through explicit Load older, and aborts or ignores stale project/unmount responses; session and state filters apply to loaded history.

A transcript card whose run is absent from the live snapshot and loaded pages can read its evidence through the existing exact-id GET route; its recorded literal path and fixed RUN_DIRECTORY shell template remain available while that read is pending or fails, and the UI starts, retries or cancels no test execution.

Newer revision-gated live summaries take precedence over older page replies, loaded history survives later snapshot omission, canonical aliases are deduplicated and explicit live restoration remains possible; existing badges, waits and live-stream behavior remain unchanged, without merging complete history into global app state.

Focused UI regressions and TypeScript checking pass on the exact candidate; an independent Codex/Claude review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree before landing. This child makes no backend snapshot-size, retention-policy or live performance improvement claim.

completion.summary: Closed the already-landed paged Test Runs UI on its own evidence, with fresh TypeScript and 23/23 panel tests passing on clean current master; no new source changes.
